description: Audit-scoped geoip enrichment of Cloud audit forwarded client IPs. Guarded to the audit dataset, which --ingest substitutes for {{DATASET}} at install time. Keys inside `attributes` are literal dotted strings (attributes['network.forwarded_ip']), so the IP is lifted with a script processor rather than a dotted `field` path; the script also accepts a nested shape in case the stream ever expands them.

script.description: Lift the literal dotted key attributes['network.forwarded_ip'] to top-level client.ip
script.source: def a = ctx.attributes; if (a == null) { return; } def ip = a.get('network.forwarded_ip'); if (ip == null && a.get('network') instanceof Map) { ip = a.get('network').get('forwarded_ip'); } if (ip == null || ip == '') { return; } if (ctx.client == null) { ctx.client = new HashMap(); } ctx.client.ip = ip;
